audit.why: Jayce owning 2-3 and the first-item window with Zac taking 6 and late matches both the prose and the mirror audit's reading of the lane. I did not touch sides; the mirror already flagged that the two layers' charts disagree with each other.
Spikes at 2-3 (Acceleration Gate), first item, 6 (Let's Bounce!, 120s at rank 1) and late are correctly placed and each names its mechanic.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cell Division is described only as blob sustain, and Unstable Matter never appears at all. The full layer carries no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Riot's text: Cell Division splits him into four bloblets on fatal damage and revives him if any survive, on a 5-minute cooldown — so a won all-in is not always a kill, and the bloblets are the real target. Unstable Matter (5s) deals a percentage of max health, which is why stacking HP against him is wrong. Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 and 9s maxed — that 21s at rank 1 is the whole early-lane safety window.
audit.corrected: State the revive, the percent-health W, and the 21s/9s Slingshot.

edits.after: 21s at rank 1, 9s maxed — his only way in, and it comes from fog.

edits.before: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: matchup-defining — His engage. E-knock/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: Reused the mirror audits/top/zac__jayce.json rather than re-researching.
